description_en: Queries the monitoring information of an ECS instance. Queryable metrics include vCPU usage, burstable instance credits, inbound data traffic, outbound data traffic, and average bandwidth
description_zh: 调用DescribeInstanceMonitorData查询一台ECS实例的监控信息。可查询的指标包括ECS实例的vCPU使用率、突发性能实例积分、接收的数据流量、发送的数据流量、平均带宽等
name: DescribeInstanceMonitorData

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the instance to query
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25696.html standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC. If the value of seconds (`ss`) is not `00`, the time is automatically rounded up to the next minute
parameters.help_zh: 获取数据的起始时间点。按照https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25696.html标准表示，并使用UTC +0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。如果指定的秒（`ss`）不是`00`，则自动换算为下一分钟。
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25696.html standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC. If the value of seconds (`ss`) is not `00`, the time is automatically rounded up to the next minute
parameters.help_zh: 获取数据的结束时间点。按照https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25696.html标准表示，并使用UTC +0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。如果指定的秒（`ss`）不是`00`，则自动换算为下一分钟。
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The interval at which to retrieve monitoring data. Unit: seconds. Valid values: 

60.
600.
3600.

Default value: 60
parameters.help_zh:
获取监控数据的间隔时间，单位：秒。取值范围： 

60。
600。
3600。

默认值：60
parameters.name: period

InstanceMonitorData.description_en: The monitoring data of the instance

BPSRead.description_en: The read bandwidth of the instance disks (including the system disk and data disks). Unit: bytes/s
BPSRead.description_zh: 实例云盘（包括系统盘和数据盘）的读带宽，单位：Byte/s

BPSWrite.description_en: The write bandwidth of the instance disks (including the system disk and data disks). Unit: bytes/s
BPSWrite.description_zh: 实例云盘（包括系统盘和数据盘）的写带宽，单位：Byte/s

CPU.description_en: The vCPU utilization of the instance. Unit: percent (%)
CPU.description_zh: 实例vCPU的使用比例，单位：百分比（%）

CPUAdvanceCreditBalance.description_en: The overdrawn CPU credits (the portion of burstable instance credits that exceeds the limit)
CPUAdvanceCreditBalance.description_zh: 超额积分（突发性能实例积分超限部分）

CPUCreditBalance.description_en: The total number of CPU credits for the burstable instance
CPUCreditBalance.description_zh: 突发性能实例积分总数

CPUCreditUsage.description_en: The number of CPU credits consumed by the burstable instance
CPUCreditUsage.description_zh: 突发性能实例已使用的积分数

IOPSRead.description_en: The I/O read operations on the instance disks (including the system disk and data disks). Unit: operations/s
IOPSRead.description_zh: 实例云盘（包括系统盘和数据盘）的I/O读操作，单位：次/s

IOPSWrite.description_en: The I/O write operations on the instance disks (including the system disk and data disks). Unit: operations/s
IOPSWrite.description_zh: 实例云盘（包括系统盘和数据盘）的I/O写操作，单位：次/s

InternetBandwidth.description_en: The public bandwidth of the instance, which is the network traffic per unit of time. Unit: kbits/s
InternetBandwidth.description_zh: 实例的公网带宽，单位时间内的网络流量，单位：kbits/s

InternetRX.description_en: The public network data traffic received by the instance during the specified interval (`Period`) at the time of the query (`TimeStamp`). Unit: kbits
InternetRX.description_zh: 在查询监控信息时（`TimeStamp`），实例在指定的间隔时间（`Period`）内接收的公网数据流量。单位：kbits

InternetTX.description_en: The public network data traffic sent by the instance during the specified interval (`Period`) at the time of the query (`TimeStamp`). Unit: kbits
InternetTX.description_zh: 在查询监控信息时（`TimeStamp`），实例在指定的间隔时间（`Period`）内发送的公网数据流量。单位：kbits

IntranetBandwidth.description_en: The internal bandwidth of the instance, which is the network traffic per unit of time. Unit: kbits/s
IntranetBandwidth.description_zh: 实例的内网带宽，单位时间内的网络流量，单位：kbits/s

IntranetRX.description_en: The internal network data traffic received by the instance during the specified interval (`Period`) at the time of the query (`TimeStamp`). Unit: kbits
IntranetRX.description_zh: 在查询监控信息时（`TimeStamp`），实例在指定的间隔时间（`Period`）内接收的内网数据流量。单位：kbits

IntranetTX.description_en: The internal network data traffic sent by the instance during the specified interval (`Period`) at the time of the query (`TimeStamp`). Unit: kbits
IntranetTX.description_zh: 在查询监控信息时（`TimeStamp`），实例在指定的间隔时间（`Period`）内发送的内网数据流量。单位：kbits

TimeStamp.description_en: The timestamp of the monitoring data
TimeStamp.description_zh: 查询监控信息的时间戳
